parameters.help_en: The name of the column encryption algorithm. The availability of AES_128_GCM, AES_256_GCM, and SM4_128_GCM depends on the instance. Select an available algorithm from ListDataMaskingEncryptionAlgorithms
parameters.help_zh: 列加密算法名称。AES_128_GCM、AES_256_GCM、SM4_128_GCM 的可用性取决于实例；从 ListDataMaskingEncryptionAlgorithms 中选择可用算法
parameters.name: enc_algorithm

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the Key Management Service (KMS) key, which can be obtained from Items[].KeyId in ListKmsKeys. Provide this parameter when using a KMS key. Do not pass this parameter in local key scenarios
parameters.help_zh: KMS 密钥标识，可从 ListKmsKeys 的 Items[].KeyId 获取。使用 KMS 密钥时提供；本地密钥场景不传
parameters.name: encryption_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The key mode. Valid values:
client_key: local key.
kms_key: KMS key.
When you use kms_key, you must specify EncryptionKeyId
parameters.help_zh: 密钥模式。client_key：本地密钥；kms_key：KMS 密钥。使用 kms_key 时需指定 EncryptionKeyId
parameters.name: encryption_key_mode

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the cloud service type. Valid values:
5: RDS.
8: POLARDB.
27: PolarDBX2.
If specified together with ProductCode, the two values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also provided, the two values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The database instance identity, which can be obtained from Items[].InstanceId in ListDataMaskingInstances
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the database engine. The value must be consistent with the EngineType of the target instance, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎类型，应与目标实例的 EngineType 一致，例如 MySQL 或 PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine_type

fields.help_en: The list of target column names. Separate multiple column names with commas
fields.help_zh: 目标列名列表，多个列名使用英文逗号分隔
fields.name: columns

fields.help_en: The name of the target database
fields.name: db_name

fields.help_en: The name of the target table
fields.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The list of column encryption targets grouped by database and table
parameters.help_zh: 按数据库和数据表分组的列加密目标列表
parameters.name: sub_rule_list

fields.help_en: The identifier of the database account, which is obtained from Items[].Id in ListDataAssetAccounts and passed as a string
fields.help_zh: 数据库账号标识，从 ListDataAssetAccounts 的 Items[].Id 获取，按字符串传入
fields.name: account_id

fields.help_en: MongoDB 账号的认证数据库；选择 MongoDB 账号时必填，其他产品无需传入
fields.help_zh: MongoDB 账号的认证数据库；选择 MongoDB 账号时必填，其他产品无需传入
fields.name: auth_db

parameters.help_en: The list of database accounts to which the fullAccess plaintext access permissions are granted. The accounts must belong to the target instance
parameters.help_zh: 需要授予 fullAccess 明文访问权限的数据库账号列表；账号必须属于目标实例
parameters.name: user_list

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the associated risk handling record. You do not need to specify this parameter in the standard column encryption creation process
parameters.help_zh: 关联的风险处理记录标识。普通列加密创建流程无需指定
parameters.name: risk_handle_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The processing method for the permission expiration time. Valid values:
PRESERVE: retains the original expiration time.
CLEAR: clears the expiration time.
SET: sets ExpireTime.
Default value: PRESERVE. Only fullAccess supports setting a validity period
parameters.help_zh: 权限到期时间的处理方式。PRESERVE：保留原到期时间；CLEAR：清除到期时间；SET：设置 ExpireTime。默认 PRESERVE。仅 fullAccess 支持设置有效期
parameters.name: expire_time_operation

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the plaintext access permissions. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970. Specify this parameter only when ExpireTimeOperation is set to SET. The value must be later than the current time and no greater than 2145953410000. The server saves the value with second-level precision. Do not pass this parameter when ExpireTimeOperation is set to PRESERVE or CLEAR
parameters.help_zh: 明文访问权限到期时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。仅 ExpireTimeOperation=SET 时填写，必须晚于当前时间且不大于 2145953410000；服务端按秒精度保存。PRESERVE 或 CLEAR 时不传
parameters.name: expire_time

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
